finding: Both sides retained their original g433 protected source session over the observed six-minute interval; no source exit history or failure events; 46 emitted 15-second heartbeat-response maximum windows were all below 100ms.

staticReview.queue: Source command reader, reply writer and watchdog share mandatory presence admission on each pinned channel; full/advisory lanes retain independent ownership.
staticReview.native: Agent presence checks the pinned process handle with zero-time WaitForSingleObject and the active console session. Full input authorization separately rechecks the console logon.
staticReview.limits: Current fixed heartbeat stages do not distinguish query-lane wait, goroutine scheduling, native call or completion publication. No current recurrence identifies one of these as defective.

decision: Preserve running g433; no speculative timeout, authority, queue or native-check change and no new generation/application.

remainingWork.task: On a renewed agent_presence ge1s failure, retain first-failure evidence and distinguish queue wait, native execution and completion publication with fixed bounded stages; do not infer native delay from aggregate time.
Treat trust freshness and initial source readiness independently if they recur; B entry readiness remains lower priority.

validation.tests: Not repeated because executable source is unchanged
validation.build: Not run; existing verified g433 retained
validation.limitations: Short observation, not a controlled low-load or physical-input acceptance test; no claim that prior agent-presence failures are permanently solved.
